title: Plugin Marketplace Schema
description: Defines the structure for a plugin marketplace configuration file.

description.description: A brief description of what the plugin does.

author.description: The author or organization providing the plugin.

harnesses.description: The agentic harnesses that this plugin is compatible with.

capabilities.description: List of capabilities provided by this plugin (e.g., 'camera', 'navigation').

entry_points.description: Mapping of capability names to their implementation paths or commands.
